sample_context: natural Ulleung Island plant used for the 2024 nuclear genome study
required_next_test: Run a paired 294-tip baseline versus 295-tip genome-augmentation comparison using the identical baseline-accepted locus intersection with the 180 strict genome-derived loci, and evaluate placement stability under a predeclared cross-data-type sensitivity before promotion.
claim_boundary: The public genome has a ready 180-locus Compositae1061 augmentation pack. This makes it a real public-data candidate tip, but it does not modify the accepted 294-tip primary tree until the cross-data-type paired-tree gate passes. It should not be conflated with the EA01/EA02 SRA mapping-sensitivity gate.
